description: Client-side image optimizer + LOOK upload recipe. A tiny browser script (optimize.js) converts a user's photo to WebP (falling back to JPEG on Safari) with resize + quality — the browser's native codec does the heavy lifting, transparency preserved — then uploads the small result to a LOOK route that stores it securely with the core request::file() + file::store(). No server-side image codec, no native dependency.
author: codlook
